name: Spatial Partitioning for Distributed NeRF
definition: A method to partition 3D space into non-overlapping tiles for distributed NeRF training by recursively splitting space based on a Probability Density Function (PDF) derived from a point cloud or ray samples, optimizing for cubic aspect ratios.
summary: Spatial Partitioning for Distributed NeRF divides 3D space into cubic tiles using scene geometry PDFs, unlike Block-NeRF's camera-based approach, to optimize distributed training load.
